notes_for_editor: Register says the cab was removed in 1953; firelookout.com and Willhite say destroyed. The story reports the disagreement and does not pick one. Not in the story: the panorama photo date differs (19 September 1934 in the register captions and on the washingtonlookouts page; 21 September in Willhite's text). The 1950 station description names the Chelan National Forest where the register and Willhite say Okanogan. Staffing rests on an April 1934 Forest Service bulletin quoted secondhand by Willhite and the washingtonlookouts page; the original bulletin was not located. No source states the access status, so facts.access is left unset. Record kind 'ground' is consistent with the sources.
